UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile containing public display information.

photoURL.description: Optional URL to the user's profile photo.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the profile was last updated.

Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description: A trip document containing name, destination, dates, and settings.

id.description: The unique identifier of the trip.

name.description: The title or name of the trip.

startDate.description: The start date of the trip in YYYY-MM-DD or readable format.

endDate.description: The end date of the trip.

context.description: A custom vibe or passenger traveler metadata string.

shareCode.description: A unique 6-character code for others to join the trip.

ownerId.description: The user UID of the trip creator and owner.

customCategories.description: Optional list of custom activity categories defined for this trip.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the trip was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the trip was last updated.

Collaborator.title: Collaborator
Collaborator.description: A member of a trip who can view, add, and edit activities.

tripId.description: The ID of the trip this collaborator belongs to.

userId.description: The user UID of the collaborator.

role.description: The role of the collaborator in this trip.

joinedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when they joined.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: An activity idea or planned event for a trip.

tripId.description: The ID of the associated trip.

category.description: The activity category (e.g. Food, Sightseeing, Rest, or custom).

notes.description: Optional notes or details about the activity.

createdBy.description: Display name of the user who created this activity.

createdByUserId.description: The user UID of the creator.

createdByPhotoURL.description: Optional photo URL of the creator.

status.description: Active state or archived status of the activity.

ItineraryPlacement.title: ItineraryPlacement
ItineraryPlacement.description: An association pinning an activity to a specific day, time, and order in the itinerary.

tripId.description: The ID of the associated trip.

activityId.description: The ID of the activity being placed.

day.description: The day label (e.g. Day 1, Day 2) or date.

addedBy.description: Display name of the user who added it to the plan.

addedByUserId.description: User UID of the user who added it.

addedByPhotoURL.description: Optional photo URL of the planner.

addedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when it was placed.

/trips/{tripId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Stores activity ideas for a trip.

/trips/{tripId}/itineraryPlacements/{pla.description: Stores itinerary assignments pinning activities to days and times.
